name: Card art and copies
what: Asks for a spread of cards, checks each has art that matches its subject (no placeholder, no watermark) and that a copied card carries its full text. A bad picture is painted again.
schedule: with the house lanes at 03:00, 09:00, 15:00, 21:00 UTC
last: Asked 6 cards. 5 had a problem: "weather in Boston": placeholder, no art; "weather in Tokyo": placeholder, no art; "weather in Denver": placeholder, no art. Still without good art: weather in Boston, weather in Tokyo, weather in Denver, tell me about tokyo, recipe for pad thai.  Recipe tone judged on 1 of 1 recipe cards.

cost.note: No paid model call from this guard. A repaint inside the free share costs nothing; the recipe tone judge runs on the free model.
